purpose: Expose truthful local evidence that a peer DAW installation entry exists in a bounded standard location without promoting installation into support, health, process, capability, preference, or execution authority.

lineage.outcome: The artist can inspect which peer DAWs N0TE positively observed in standard local installation locations while seeing an explicit boundary that non-detection is unknown and detection is not proof of control or support.

why_now: DAW-00 is dependency-ready because CORE-03 and CORE-04 are DONE. Canonical REQ-SCOPE-012 requires peer-DAW continuity and explicitly separates detection from support. Current host identity and capability evidence foundations accept supplied observations but do not provide a consumer-reachable bounded local installation inventory.

implementation_contract.positive_truth: Only a safe regular installation entry found inside a bounded standard root may be reported as OBSERVED local installation evidence.
implementation_contract.negative_truth: No match is UNKNOWN, never proof that a DAW is absent or unsupported.
implementation_contract.support_boundary: Installation observation never creates HostRuntimeIdentity, CapabilityObservation, adapter support, process liveness, preference, or execution eligibility.
implementation_contract.privacy: The consumer surface names the DAW family and observation class but never exposes local filesystem paths.
implementation_contract.persistence: Inventory is ephemeral and rescanned when rendered; it does not become durable Artist/Song memory automatically.
implementation_contract.mutation: Scanning does not launch a DAW, open a project, write files, call providers, mutate canonical product state, or grant authority.

completion_proof: bounded standard-location scanner reports positive peer-DAW installation observations on supported platform layouts
non-detection remains explicitly UNKNOWN rather than MISSING or UNSUPPORTED
symlink or root-escape candidates cannot establish positive installation evidence
installation observations carry no support, capability, health, preference, process or execution fields
Settings exposes the inventory read-only without private filesystem paths
consumer copy states that detected installation is not adapter support or control
rendering or rescanning creates no durable Artist/Song/capability state and launches nothing
full regression and staged consumer smoke pass at exact head
